steps.input:
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    # The painted stripes run along one of the two diagonal directions.
    diff_lines = {c - r for r, c, _ in cells}
    sum_lines = {c + r for r, c, _ in cells}
    use_sum = len(sum_lines) < len(diff_lines)
    line_of = (lambda r, c: r + c) if use_sum else (lambda r, c: c - r)
    line_ids = {line_of(r, c) for r, c, _ in cells}
    period = len(line_ids)
    colors = {}
    for r, c, color in cells:
        residue = line_of(r, c) % period
        if residue in colors and colors[residue] != color:
            raise ValueError('inconsistent stripe colors')
        colors[residue] = color
    return [[colors[line_of(r, c) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
